author: Brandt, 1843
status: 겨울철새 수만 마리 · 텃새 수천 마리
habitat: 저지대 관목림, 농경지, 풀밭 같은 트인 곳, 인가 주변

months.note: 번식기는 4~7월이며, 한 해에 두 번 번식하기도 한다.

summary: 흔한 텃새로, 주로 낮은 지대의 관목림이나 농경지, 풀밭 같은 트인 곳에 살아 인가 가까이에서도 자주 보인다. 언뜻 보면 크기와 빛깔이 참새와 비슷하다.

sexes.male: 수컷은 눈앞과 뺨선(턱선)이 검고 귀깃과 머리꼭대기·가슴의 밤색이 짙어, 흰 눈썹선·뺨과 또렷이 대비된다.
sexes.female: 암컷은 머리꼭대기가 더 갈색이고 귀깃이 엷은 담황갈색이며, 눈썹선이 담황색을 띠고 뺨선이 갈색이며 가슴의 밤색 띠가 흐리다.

young: 어린새는 얼굴 무늬가 흐릿하고 온몸이 엷은 갈색을 띠며, 가슴과 옆구리에 검은 갈색 세로줄이 뚜렷하다. 첫겨울 수컷은 어른 암컷과 비슷하다.

similar.how: 크기와 빛깔이 언뜻 비슷하지만, 멧새는 꼬리가 더 길고 흰 눈썹선과 꼬리 양쪽의 흰 깃이 눈에 띈다.

art.subject: Meadow Bunting (Emberiza cioides), adult male, as seen year-round in Korean farmland and scrub: crown and nape chestnut-brown; long white supercilium; black lores and a dark chestnut to blackish ear-covert patch; white submoustachial stripe and black malar stripe; white chin and throat; mantle rufous-brown streaked black; rump plain rufous-brown; wings brown with rufous fringes; breast unstreaked rich chestnut-orange, flanks rufous-buff, belly pale buff to whitish; long dark tail with white outer tail feathers. Conical bill grey, darker on the upper mandible; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.pose: perched on top of a low shrub at a field edge, side view
art.scene: Korean countryside: low scrub along farmland and open grassy ground near a village; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched on a shrub top: chestnut crown, long white supercilium, dark ear-covert patch, white submoustachial stripe, black malar, white throat, unstreaked chestnut-orange breast, streaked rufous-brown back, long tail
adult female, side view perched: the same pattern but duller, with brown ear-coverts, buff-white supercilium and a paler buff-orange breast
adult in flight, seen from above: streaked rufous-brown back, plain rufous rump, long dark tail with conspicuous white outer tail feathers
art.build: Medium-sized bunting, about as big in the body as a sparrow but slimmer and with a noticeably longer tail; rounded head with no crest. Perches upright on bush tops and wires to sing. Bill conical and sharply pointed, shorter than the head. Legs medium length, pinkish. Tail long and slightly notched, dark brown with conspicuous white outer feathers flashed in flight. Rump plain rufous, not streaked.
avoid: Do not paint a black bib or a black spot on a white cheek; that is Eurasian Tree Sparrow (Passer montanus), which also has a short tail.
Do not streak the breast; streaked breast bands belong to Chestnut-eared Bunting (Emberiza fucata), while this species has a plain chestnut breast.
Do not add a crest; the crown is smoothly rounded.
Do not make the tail short or leave out the white outer tail feathers.
